gap_1_queue_shim_injected_into_every_spa.description: _QUEUE_AUTONOMY_BLOCK is injected into every agent spawn prompt by default (queue_autonomy=True). This block instructs agents to call 7x_queue_ops.py, which references the deprecated sprint-queue.json linear queue that was officially deprecated on 2026-04-27. Agents in production spawns are receiving instructions to call a deprecated script path that may not exist or be routed correctly. This means every W1/W2/W3 spawn is carrying dead routing instructions that contradict the compass navigation protocol.
evidence: CLAUDE.md mth00101 — compass navigation is the ONLY routing protocol; queue is dead
gap_1_queue_shim_injected_into_every_spa.fix: Replace _QUEUE_AUTONOMY_BLOCK with a FRONTIER_SCAN_BLOCK that instructs agents to scan forensics/{date}/manifests/ for investigation_label-matched open edges. No 7x_queue_ops.py references. Pure compass navigation.
gap_1_queue_shim_injected_into_every_spa.effort: 0.5 days — string constant replacement + regression test that no spawned prompt mentions queue_ops

gap_2_missing_maps_to_official_type_on_m.description: Only 2 of the active agent cards (python-pro, stigmergy-scout) declare maps_to_official_type in frontmatter. The remaining active cards (fullstack-developer, code-reviewer, architect, coc-manager, context-manager, data-scientist, equilibrium-auditor, membot, report-writer, team-builder, etc.) have no maps_to_official_type field. SPAWN-CARD-PROTOCOL.md states this field is required for correct routing: card name -> maps_to_official_type -> Agent(subagent_type=...). Without this field, spawn routing is ambiguous — callers must guess the official type or hardcode it.
evidence: grep -n maps_to_official_type on fullstack-developer.md: zero results
grep -n maps_to_official_type on code-reviewer.md: zero results
grep -n maps_to_official_type on architect.md: zero results
gap_2_missing_maps_to_official_type_on_m.fix: Add maps_to_official_type frontmatter to all active agent cards. Use the Claude SDK official types: general-purpose, ai-engineer, data-scientist, code-reviewer, etc.
gap_2_missing_maps_to_official_type_on_m.effort: 1 day — read each card, determine correct official type mapping, edit frontmatter

gap_3_f0_token_estimate_is_4x_heuristic_.description: The f(0) context burden ratio is computed with agent_tokens = main_tokens * 4 (hardcoded heuristic). The formula-audit manifest (04-59-44Z) explicitly identified this as the biggest measurement gap: 'f(0) is asserted, not measured.' Phase 1 instrumentation is wired (good), but the denominator is synthetic. Until actual API response token counts are wired in, f(0) metric cannot be trusted for phase gate decisions. The phase gates (SEED/DEEPEN/EXTEND/FULL) are supposed to advance on quality_score + belief_index thresholds, not f(0) directly, but the FFMx calculation and velocity acceleration roadmap depends on real token counts.
evidence: 04-59-44Z formula-audit manifest: 'biggest_gap: f(0) is asserted, not measured'
14-00-00Z phase1-instrumentation manifest: known_gaps[0] = 'f0 agent_tokens estimate is 4x heuristic'
gap_3_f0_token_estimate_is_4x_heuristic_.fix: Phase 3 work: wire actual API response token counts (from Claude API usage field) into log_f0_to_session_metrics(). Requires PostToolUse hook to capture api_response.usage.output_tokens per Agent() call and pass to the metrics writer.

gap_4_sibling_manifest_scan_o2_without_p.description: The 0x_prescan_cache.py module exists and is correct, but it is NOT imported or called from 0x_spawn_template.py. The sibling manifest scan still uses the O(N^2) direct filesystem pattern (iterdir + sort + per-file stat + per-file read). The code-reviewer audit artifact (053017Z) documented this precisely: 21 read_text() calls, 19 json.loads(), 6 glob operations per spawn, multiplied by 4-5 W1 parallel agents = 100+ file I/O ops at liftoff. The cache module is ready; it just needs to be imported and wired into _collect_sibling_context() and potentially the prescan gate in agent prompts.
evidence: 0x_spawn_template.py: no import of prescan_cache anywhere (grep returns 0 hits)
Velocity audit artifact (053017Z) issue #1: N^2 sibling scan, recommended session-level cache
knowledge-synthesizer manifest (053017Z): Priority 1 = cache prescan results, 10x ROI
gap_4_sibling_manifest_scan_o2_without_p.fix: Import prescan_cache in 0x_spawn_template.py and replace the _collect_sibling_context() direct scan with cached lookups. 1-sprint work per the velocity synthesis.
gap_4_sibling_manifest_scan_o2_without_p.effort: 1 day — import + wire cache into _collect_sibling_context() + test

gap_5_mission_graph_script_absent_from_f.description: CLAUDE.md and all manifests reference python3 .claude/scripts/0x_mission_graph.py --query topology/open-edges/blockers/chains as the primary compass navigation tool. This script exists in the faerie2 repo (/mnt/d/0local/gitrepos/faerie2/.claude/scripts/) but is NOT present in faerie-vault or in ~/.claude/scripts/. The faerie-vault is described as the human interface template. For shipping as a standalone product, the mission graph querying capability must be self-contained or clearly documented as a faerie2 dependency.
evidence: CLAUDE.md Compass Navigation Protocol: python3 .claude/scripts/0x_mission_graph.py --query topology
gap_5_mission_graph_script_absent_from_f.fix: Either: (A) copy/symlink 0x_mission_graph.py into ~/.claude/scripts/ as the canonical shared location, or (B) document the faerie2 repo dependency explicitly in faerie-vault START-HERE.md as a prerequisite.
gap_5_mission_graph_script_absent_from_f.effort: 0.5 days — copy script + update path references in CLAUDE.md

gap_6_stigmergy_scout_references_depreca.description: The stigmergy-scout agent card (the most-used routing agent) still contains Phase 2 compass scan code that reads sprint-queue.json directly (line 36) and calls 7x_queue_ops.py for ROUTE and FLAG decisions (lines 84-85, 98). This contradicts the deprecation notice and the compass navigation protocol. A scout that follows its own card will try to manipulate a deprecated queue, creating silent failures or no-ops.
gap_6_stigmergy_scout_references_depreca.fix: Rewrite stigmergy-scout Phase 2 and Phase 3 to use manifest filesystem discovery (grep forensics/manifests/ for investigation_label) instead of queue reads, and replace 7x_queue_ops.py calls with manifest writes to forensics/manifests/.
gap_6_stigmergy_scout_references_depreca.effort: 1 day — rewrite Phase 2 compass scan section + Phase 3 ROUTE/FLAG actions
